parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small flush button located on the top of the toilet tank, typically made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the flushing mechanism when pressed, releasing water from the tank into the bowl.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically or pivots slightly when pressed, returning to its original position after release.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: A flat cover placed on top of the toilet tank, made of molded plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the tank to protect internal components and provide a clean appearance.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or removed for maintenance or cleaning but remains stationary during normal use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the toilet, made of glazed ceramic, forming the bowl and pedestal.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the user, holds water, and channels waste into the drainage system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving structure anchored to the floor.
